title: Large Envelopes and Mailing Labels
slide_intent: Teach designers to preserve the order of sender, postal mark and recipient when the available mailing surface changes.
strategic_value: NASA can keep its headquarters and centers recognizable on a large envelope and on a small adhesive label.
demonstration: The large envelope uses black ink. Two 3 × 5 inch labels below show the red-logo and one-color alternatives with different sender details.
practical_value: Specify black ink on white or Kraft stock for the large envelope. Use the label examples when fitting a sender identity and an address into the smaller format.

content_islands.name: Format specifications
content_islands.spec: Set the heading and short sections for large envelopes and mailing labels across the top. Retain dimensions, type settings, stock and color instructions.

content_islands.name: Large envelope
content_islands.spec: Show a single wide envelope with identification at upper left, postal information at upper right and the recipient nearer the center.

content_islands.name: Label alternatives
content_islands.spec: Align two samples side by side beneath the envelope. Keep the postal block and typed delivery address visible in each.
